rationale: Identity: the held original (77 FR 54779, Aug. 30, 2012) is Executive Order 13624 on industrial energy efficiency and combined heat and power. Its directions in section 2 are continuing and have no sunset; the end-of-2020 date in 2(a) is the target date of a national goal and does not end the order. The held 42 U.S.C. 6341 note file (release point 119-121, sha256 verified) prints sections 1 to 3 in full with no ending statement. The held Department of Energy notice FR Doc. 2026-00153 (91 FR 704, Jan. 8, 2026) still cites the order as authority and does not end it. No held later order names 13624, the eCFR search has no hit, and the catalog search shows no later event. The 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 statute gap is disclosed and nothing held points to an act in it. Provisional yes is supported.
